text.en:
Meena read the board in her school listing the rights of every child.
"Rights come with duties," said her teacher.

The Constitution gives every citizen fundamental rights such as equality, freedom, protection from exploitation, freedom of religion, cultural and educational rights and the right to constitutional remedies.
It also lists fundamental duties, such as respecting the Constitution, the flag and anthem, protecting the environment and public property, and developing a scientific outlook.
Rights and duties go together: using our rights means respecting others' rights.

prompt.en: A friend says citizens have rights but no duties. How will you reply?
